_meta.source: The 'Level plan' tables in dossiers/*.md, in the form the engine applies at level-up (pqc.progression.advance).
_meta.fields: subclass: chosen at the class's subclass level. levels.<n>: expertise (skills), spellbook (wizard spells added), prepare (spells added to the prepared list, up to the class limit), cantrips (added), asi ({ability: +n}). Spells must exist in data/spells.json to be prepared; others are reported as still to add.
